approvers: Owner decides alone; client or main contractor would object to any frame risk
reason: The aluminium already arrives with factory film, and that is what protects the frames on site. I have no budget line for this and I am not putting a sprayed coating on coated glass and finished frames when any residue or mark comes back to me.
objection: A coating sprayed onto installed coated glass and frames could stain, mark or leave residue when it peels. I would be liable for that, and I get no benefit over the factory film.
instead: Keep the factory film, add taped edge protection and cardboard where needed, and make sure the other trades are careful.
would_change_my_mind: Written approval from the glazing and coating manufacturers that it is compatible with their warranty, plus a reference from a premium block with no marks after removal.
